blocks.text: Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, known for strengthening ties between Japan and China but who struggled to manage affairs in a divided Diet during his one-year stint through September 2008, has died, the ruling Liberal Democratic Party said Monday. He was 90. Sources familiar with the matter said the former prime minister died in Tokyo on Thursday from heart failure. A funeral was held privately for close family members only, with a public memorial service to take place at a later date.
